items.item: 63 rows cite a competition or rankings page, not the individual fixture
items.detail: The official URL on these rows is an official governing-body or league page, but it does not itself identify the fixture. Examples: all 18 darts rows cite pdc.tv/rankings; all 15 tennis rows cite the ATP/WTA rankings or tournament overview; all 6 greyhound rows cite the GBGB results index; the 4 EuroCup rows cite the EuroCup standings. The fixture ID, date and opponent on those rows rest on the OLBG listing captured on 2026-10-21. They are published with the source scope disclosed as 'competition', not 'fixture'.

items.item: 20 pre-existing high-confidence picks are all shorter than -250; 13 band picks priced 1.40-1.42 were added
items.detail: The brief asks for high-confidence picks between -250 (decimal 1.40) and +10000 (decimal 101.00). A selection with a 70%+ model probability cannot be priced above 1.43, so only a 70.0-71.4% window satisfies both rules. All 20 original high-confidence selections carry fair odds of 1.02-1.39 and therefore fall outside the requested band; they remain published and labelled 'outside band'. Thirteen handicap/total selections at 1.40-1.42, each with a written prediction and official facts, were originated to meet the band.

items.item: 59 of 155 rows are dated 2026-10-21 and had already started or finished at the 2026-10-22 01:30Z snapshot
items.detail: This is a dated capture, not a live feed. Rows dated before 2026-10-22 are labelled 'past' on every table; 36 rows are dated 2026-10-22 and 60 are dated later. No result has been back-filled and no past row is presented as an upcoming tip.

items.item: All 11 NBA rows are 2026-10-21 fixtures; the 2026-10-22 slate was not captured
items.detail: nba.com's games calendar rendered 2 games for 22 October 2026, 12 for 23 October and 8 for 24 October, but the page returned 'Sorry, something went wrong' for the fixture list. The NBA static scoreboard endpoint returned HTTP 500 and stats.nba.com did not respond. No NBA fixture was invented to fill the gap.

items.item: New Zealand v India is dated 2026-10-23 06:15 UTC in the verified desk and 2026-10-22 in the root layer
items.detail: ICC match 271646 is cited by both layers, but the root dashboard stores 2026-10-22 03:00 while the verified desk stores 2026-10-23 06:15 UTC.
